Ben Carter: Heads up — I just pulled the March invoice for eu-west1 and there's a 'GPU Software Surcharge' line that appears twice with identical qty and amount. Not sure if this is a provider-side dup or something in our credits mapping.
Priya Rao: Ugh. Can you paste the invoice lines so we can see the raw entries?
Ben Carter: ```
Invoice: INV-2026-03-15
Line A: SKU=GPU_SOFTWARE_SURCHARGE | Region=eu-west1 | Qty=1200 hours | Unit=$0.32 | Amount=$384.00
Line B: SKU=GPU_SOFTWARE_SURCHARGE | Region=eu-west1 | Qty=1200 hours | Unit=$0.32 | Amount=$384.00
Total duplicate delta: $768.00
```
Josh Li: Did we flip any licensing or telemetry metering flags in early March? I remember a metering agent bump on 2026-03-10.
Maya Patel: We upgraded the driver on the dedicated fleet but there's no license toggle in that rollout. Driver update shouldn't create a new "software surcharge" SKU.
Ben Carter: Opening a case with the provider now. Filing as INC-8942, will paste the ticket.
BillingBot: Support case INC-8942 opened with provider (priority=Normal). Initial response ETA 72h. Case URL: https://provider.support/cases/INC-8942
Priya Rao: Can you also attach the committed use / reservation report? Need to confirm that commitment credits weren't applied twice or missed.
Ben Carter: Attached commit report: https://internal-storage.redwood/commits/commit-report-2026-03.csv
Josh Li: I'll run a quick query against our metering sink to see if ingestion duplicated events. /assign me
Maya Patel: If provider admits duplication, ask for invoice adjustment + confirmation that future billing will be corrected for that month. Also request a breakdown by billing tag so we can cross-check with our internal meter IDs.
Ben Carter: Good call. I'll request a per-SKU breakdown and the mapping to their meter IDs. I'll update this thread once they reply. :thumbsup:
